releaseNotes: fix: one-click name repair now deletes worksheet-scoped names through their own sheet collection and workbook-scoped names only after their worksheet twins are gone — unambiguous in real Excel, so selecting all 8 fixes fixes all 8 in one pass
fix: a workbook-scoped name that does not resolve to exactly one entry is refused with an exact reason instead of deleting a same-text twin; a failed transaction still rolls back completely

fix: the report can no longer carry both the external-dependency root and a 'no formula uses' claim for the same workbook file — one canonical external state per source; UI and report counts always agree
improved: every name repair step logs safe diagnostics (resolved name texts, collection, delete result, fresh re-verification) so real Excel behavior is provable from the audit log
improved: undo restores worksheet-scoped names through their own sheet collection first
